---
title: Why a small Quarto
date: 2026-10-09
author: Rahul Dave
categories: [design, release]
---

Quarto is a fine tool, and a large one: it brings Pandoc, Deno, Sass, esbuild and Typst, more than
600 MB, to make PDFs, books, slides and websites, and to run code. Many projects use it for one
thing, a docs site from Markdown and the code. smalldocs does that one thing in one Python package
that installs from PyPI.

The design rests on one fact: a Bootstrap 5.3 theme exposes its colours and fonts as CSS variables.
So smalldocs needs no Sass to give the page any theme's look. It takes the plain CSS that Bootswatch
publishes, and lays the page out with a stylesheet that uses only those variables.
